purpose: Teach: 立ち向かう/人命/自白/撃っ/都知事/親近/疎通/便乗

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の困難、本気で、当社、絶対、立ち向かう姿勢、見せていけ、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、本当に、これは、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: We face the industry's challenges head-on. I want to see that resolve in every action we take. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Measured authority. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. Steady pace, no rush. Eyes holding the room. A man who has made decisions others feared to make.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の人命、本気で、第一に、当社、絶対、考えてまいります、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、本当に、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our people come first—always. That's the principle we operate from. Thank you for trusting us with this.
lines.style: Formal but genuine. Straightforward delivery. A slight pause before the affirmation, as if he's making an internal commitment. Respectful without performed deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 不正、本気で、自白する勇気、社員に、絶対、求めていけ、本気で、コンプラ、徹底だ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Anyone who discovers wrongdoing—I want them to have the courage to come forward. Compliance isn't a checkbox. It's how we build trust.
lines.style: Firm conviction without harshness. The words settle into the room. A man explaining principle to someone who already understands its weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合と、撃って、跳ね返す市場、本気で、生き残る、戦略、絶対、進めます、本気で、本当に、頑張ります、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Understood. We'll compete fiercely in the market, but we do it on our terms. That's the strategy we're committing to.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. No bombast. The tone of someone who has thought through the path and will walk it. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 都知事との関係、本気で、当社、絶対、大事にしていけ、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、本当に、これは、絶対、お父さんから、頼まれた。
lines.en: Our relationship with Tokyo's leadership matters. Protect that. This was something my father emphasized to me, and I'm passing it forward.
lines.style: Momentary softness underlying steel. A glimpse into what shaped him. Slower pace. The personal stakes slip through the professional mask.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様への、親近感、本気で、社員、絶対、感じてもらえるよう、頑張ってまいります、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We want customers to feel that our people genuinely care. That's not a slogan—it's how we operate.
lines.style: Earnest and clear. The tone of someone translating conviction into action. A slight rise of energy as he commits to the goal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、意思疎通、絶対、徹底させろ、本気で、コミュニケーション、当社の、本気で、命綱だ、本当に、絶対、本気で、頼んだぞ。
lines.en: Communication across the team is the lifeline of this company. Make it absolute. There's no substitute for it.
lines.style: Intensity rising slightly. The metaphor carries weight. A man who has seen silence destroy organizations. Direct and unwavering.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。流行に、本気で、便乗するばかりではなく、絶対、当社の独自性、本気で、貫いてまいります、本気で、感謝、絶対、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We won't just chase trends. We'll hold to what makes us distinctive. That's our edge, and we'll protect it.
lines.style: Strong closing note. The voice tightens with resolve. A man ending the conversation with full understanding of what's expected. Calm but absolute.
